title: pseudocyclosorus duclouxii
intro: Pseudocyclosorus duclouxii, commonly known as the Ducloux's fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to China and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues. The Ducloux's fern is believed to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases like cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Pseudocyclosorus duclouxii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities.
